thought.text: Now let me start the Maven build. This is a large multi-module build, so I'll run it in the background and monitor progress:

reasoning_content:
Maven 3.9.16 is already installed. Next, start the build. This is a large-scale multi-module build. Use `mvn clean install` per the README, with `-Pdistribution` to include the distribution module, `-DskipTests` to skip tests, and `-B -ntp` for batch output. It's also possible to skip OWASP dependency-check — it's already set to `<dependency-check.skip>true</dependency-check.skip>` by default.

The build could take a long time (over an hour). Each terminal command has a 600-second timeout. So the build needs to be run in the background using nohup, and progress needs to be polled.

Let me kick off the build in the background with nohup and monitor it.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup mvn clean install -Pdistribution -DskipTests -B -ntp -Dmaven.artifact.threads=8 > /workspace/build.log 2>&1 &
echo "Build started with PID $!"; sleep 30; tail -5 /workspace/build.log
